### 页面构造
需绘制单面板双轴复合图：29根年度柱、29点折线、左右纵轴、斜排年份、水平网格、下置图例，以及蓝底白字标题栏和来源/注释。最难的是精确读值：左轴间隔20，右轴间隔25个百分点，且无数据标签；31在2002和2011附近重复，30%、40%等也可能对应多个近似点。我不确定目标百分比是原始整数还是按折线位置取整。

components.evidence: Left axis runs 0–80; right axis runs 0%–100%.
Blue bars and a light-blue line occupy the same panel.
“Source: Authors’ calculations” and “Note: The figure displays” appear below the plot.
The two-item legend sits directly below the year axis.
Axis titles begin “Number of” and “Share of”; percentage scale appears on the right axis.
Both long value-axis titles run vertically beside their respective axes.
Year labels from 1995 through 2023 are angled diagonally.
Horizontal rules align with 0, 20, 40, 60 and 80; no vertical gridlines appear.
